clock.name: perf_counter_ns
clock.utc_mapping: bracketed startup/readiness/header/exit/final anchors; no guarantee against between-anchor UTC steps

capture.startup_coordination: owned strace child suspended on one reverse port; verified OS observer ready before collector resumes that same endpoint
capture.target_stderr_scope: owned target plus strace diagnostics combined

event_loss.status: EventPipe analysis required; strace provides no kernel loss count

limits: strace, EventPipe, startup coordination, proc polling and rundown perturb this SAME target execution.
futex wall intervals include scheduling/ptrace and may restart; they are not CPU time or proof of a managed lock owner.
Native syscalls/CPU counters and runtime GC episodes require bounded clock/TID correlation before attribution.
Buffer payload contents are suppressed; caller must supply credential-free arguments and fixture output.
Child stdout/stderr and syscall file/address metadata are retained, not scrubbed.
I/O includes diagnostic IPC; logical byte returns/mmap/waits are not physical disk latency.
Scheduler counters remain sampled partial lifetime; no exact CSwitch or privilege changes.
Restarted/incomplete/unparsed raw records remain explicit; unknown native loss is never zero.
capture.source_provenance_scope: Frozen import-time source bytes match loaded function/method code and inventory; fingerprints checked before/after capture. Globals/defaults/imported bindings are not attested; trusted caller/checkout, not immutable execution attestation.
capture.prelaunch_hashing_scope: Hashing/preparation can prime filesystem caches; not cold disk
capture.header_timing_scope: post-resume acknowledgment upper bound, never the exact resume clock
capture.target_exit_clock_scope: upper bound after strace followed-group completion; exact target exit remains in native raw lifecycle

summary.scope: diagnostic sampled native OS counters only, never exact scheduler events or benchmark evidence
summary.initial_coverage: first successful snapshot; startup before it is not event-traced
summary.timing_clock: perf_counter_ns; legacy monotonic_ns is distinct and must not be joined to QPC
summary.flush_policy: flush each JSON line; no fsync/power-loss guarantee

capabilities.scheduler: per-thread cumulative schedstat and context-switch samples; not event trace
capabilities.schedstat_zero_policy: raw zero is not evidence of no wait; require supported/enabled counters
capabilities.io_scope: logical/syscall and accounted storage counters if supported, not file latency

native_summary.scope: ptrace-observed syscall intervals/counts, not physical disk latency or benchmark timing
native_summary.loss_status: strace supplies no kernel event-loss counter; incomplete/unparsed input retained

limits: Instrumented and traced work is perturbed and never performance acceptance.
GC suspension start-to-restart-stop includes rendezvous/restart; stop-to-restart-start is the narrower all-suspended window. Background GC lifetime is not a pause.
JIT start-to-load is an elapsed interval, not compiler CPU time; background-thread overlap is not proven caller stall. Rundown loads are excluded from matching.
Sample profiler observes managed thread stacks, not OS on-CPU, native stacks, scheduling waits or physical file IO. Use separate OS tracing for those claims.
Clock mapping assumes the event timestamp occurs during the recorded logging call. Every per-marker interval and their intersection are retained; inconsistent mapping is uncertain.
Missing/unmatched events, payload errors, loss or failed stack extraction are retained rather than silently treated as complete evidence.
No external symbol server is configured; available JIT/rundown managed names only. Native/PDB source line resolution is not claimed.

Unassigned diagnostic gaps include UTF8/source-string material construction, logger bookkeeping, pretty final report and final buffered sidecar serialization; a small SHA/hex span does not prove those costs absent.

root_quality.os_coverage_scope: sampled only; partial status and first/last lifetime gaps retained in capture
limits: Parser completion is separate from capture/attribution quality.
OS dimensions remain sampled or unavailable per observer; no kernel CSwitch/physical disk claim.
